name: @vehicle-pulse/backend-root
description: VehiclePulse - Real-Time Telemetry & Event Streaming Platform Backend

scripts.type-check: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const hasWs=fs.existsSync('packages') && fs.readdirSync('packages').some(f => !f.startsWith('.')); if(hasWs) require('child_process').execSync('npm run type-check --workspaces --if-present', {stdio:'inherit'}); else console.log('No backend workspace packages yet (will activate in Phase 2).');"
